title: White dragon-deer mount and departure
purpose: Validate the next-segment handoff after SC03: use the white dragon-deer reveal, Dragon Pool assets, Wufeng prop correction, and the next destination reference to create a clean departure segment.

continuity_from.caveat: SC03 SH03 is pending human review and may contain Wufeng ambiguity. SC04 prompts explicitly lock Wufeng as a blunt rectangular edgeless black iron object.

image_reference_policy: Use one strong reference image per storyboard workflow. SH01 uses the previous SC03 dragon-deer storyboard for continuity. SH02 uses the approved white dragon-deer creature reference. SH03 uses the approved Yupingshan/Tianhu location reference as the destination handoff.
video_policy: Gemini experimental I2V should use only the generated storyboard image as source of truth. Do not pass character, creature, location, or tail-frame refs into video generation unless testing a specific provider contract.

shots.title: Trust after the dragon-deer reveal
shots.storyboard_prompt: Use the input previous storyboard as continuity anchor, but correct the prop language. Cinematic realistic ancient Chinese mythic fantasy storyboard frame, widescreen composition. Adult Tuobaye age 28 to 32 stands on the safe mossy stone bank of the Dragon Pool, rugged grey-brown rough cloth layers, rope belt, travel pouch, green bamboo flute visible, relic bundle secure. He lowers a plain dark blunt rectangular edgeless black iron Wufeng object, not a sharp sword, while the friendly white dragon-deer leans forward through soft mist. White dragon-deer full body visible: white fur, pearl scales along neck and shoulders, pale jade antler curves, long white mane, calm intelligent eyes. Trust, wonder, and departure readiness. Cold jade water, waterfall mist, ancient pine roots, glowing herbs, safe terrain, no attack, no chase, no injury, no text.
shots.video_prompt: Animate this storyboard frame as an 8-10 second trust beat. The white dragon-deer lowers its head gently while Tuobaye relaxes and lowers the blunt Wufeng iron object. Preserve adult Tuobaye, green bamboo flute, relic bundle, white dragon-deer identity, Dragon Pool mist, safe stone bank, and quiet trust. No attack, no chase, no injury, no sharp blade emphasis, no text.

shots.title: Mounting the white dragon-deer
shots.storyboard_prompt: Use the input white dragon-deer reference as the creature anchor. Cinematic realistic ancient Chinese mythic fantasy storyboard frame, widescreen composition. Adult Tuobaye age 28 to 32 carefully climbs onto the friendly white dragon-deer beside the Dragon Pool valley exit, with one hand on its long white mane and one foot on a safe low mossy rock. This is calm cooperation, not combat. Tuobaye wears rugged grey-brown rough cloth, rope belt, travel pouch, green bamboo flute visible, relic bundle fastened, plain dark blunt rectangular edgeless Wufeng iron object secured low at his side. White dragon-deer remains noble and consistent: white fur, pearl neck scales, pale jade antlers, calm eyes, graceful strong legs. Moonlit mist, cold jade water behind them, mountain valley path ahead, no saddle, no fall, no injury, no text.
shots.video_prompt: Animate this storyboard frame as an 8-10 second safe mounting shot. Tuobaye places one hand on the white dragon-deer's mane and settles carefully while the creature stays calm. Preserve the creature reference, adult Tuobaye costume, bamboo flute, relic bundle, blunt Wufeng iron object, Dragon Pool valley exit, and cooperative mood. No falling, no violence, no injury, no text.
